cd /app/dev && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, random
rng = random.Random(3)
K = 8
NF = 32
schema = [{'name':'f%d'%i,'type':'SIZE','min':0,'max':1000} for i in range(NF)]
def deep_term(depth):
    if depth == 1:
        return {'field':'f%d'%rng.randrange(NF),'at':rng.randrange(K)}
    return {'add':[deep_term(depth-1), deep_term(depth-1)]}
atoms = []
for a in range(20):
    body = {'cmp':'ge','left':{'scale':rng.randint(1,5),'term':deep_term(3)},
            'right':{'const':-2000000,'type':'SIZE'}}   # always true -> no short circuit
    atoms.append({'quantifier':'all','from':0,'to':K-1,'predicate':body})
def mktrace(tid, src, n):
    ts = rng.sample(range(0, 10*n+50), n)
    rows = [{'t':t,'values':[rng.randint(0,1000) for _ in range(NF)]} for t in ts]
    rng.shuffle(rows)
    return {'id':tid,'source':src,'rows':rows}
train = [mktrace('tr%d'%i, 's%d'%(i%16), 257) for i in range(16)]
probes = [mktrace('pr','s0',135)]
queries = [mktrace('qr','s0',1031)]
req = {'version':1,'schema':schema,'window':K,'atoms':atoms,
       'policy':{'max_width':4,'min_support':1,'min_witness':1},
       'train':train,'probes':probes,'queries':queries}
json.dump(req, open('stress5.json','w'))
print('ok')
PYEOF
cd /app/dev && (time /app/submission/run.sh < stress5.json > out5.json) 2>&1 | tail -4
